title: Standing List and Range Specification: Office Pantry & Beverage Program
content:
The range a stocked pantry carries under the Office Pantry & Beverage Program is specified tier by tier: how many distinct products stand on the list, how many of them are fresh or chilled, how many coffee brands are offered, how many seasonal products rotate on each quarter, how deep the dietary and allergen range runs, and whether paper goods and consumption reporting form part of the tier.

| Tier | Distinct products on the standing list | Distinct fresh and chilled products | Coffee brands offered | Seasonal products rotated on each quarter | Depth of the dietary and allergen range | Cups, napkins and cutlery included | Monthly waste and consumption reporting included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 24 | 0 | 2 | 2 | basic | yes | no |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 85 | 8 | 3 | 4 | basic | yes | no |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 160 | 45 | 4 | 8 | standard | yes | yes |
| Barista Bar Program | 140 | 35 | 6 | 12 | enhanced | yes | yes |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 240 | 85 | 7 | 16 | enhanced | yes | yes |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 310 | 110 | 8 | 24 | enhanced | yes | yes |

## The measures as this specification states them

- The product count is the number of distinct products carried on the standing list, and the fresh count is the number of those that are fresh or chilled products.
- The coffee figure is the number of distinct coffee brands on the standing list.
- The seasonal figure is the number of seasonal products rotated onto the list each quarter.
- The depth of the dietary and allergen range carried takes one of three values: basic, standard or enhanced.
- Cups, napkins and cutlery are recorded against the tier as included in the programme fee or not; monthly waste and consumption reporting is recorded the same way.

## Reading the range figures

The product count does not rise monotonically across the tiers. Barista Bar Program carries 140 distinct products against the 160 carried by Fresh Pantry Program below it, while offering 6 coffee brands against that tier's 4; the barista tier is specified for a deeper beverage range on a shorter standing list. Coffee & Tea Service is the one tier whose fresh and chilled count stands at 0.
